title: MULTIBENCH++: A Unified and Comprehensive Multimodal Fusion Benchmarking Across Specialized Domains
reasoning: The paper includes specific tasks and datasets dedicated to detecting ethically and socially sensitive content, such as misogyny (MAMI dataset), offensive content (Memotion, MultiOFF datasets), and harmful troll-like behavior or hate speech (MUTE dataset). These represent a benchmark component focused on the ethics of content moderation.
